# `project.settings.set`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/project.settings.set.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`project.settings.set` (`SetProjectSettings`): sets one member of the project settings.

`member` must name an entry of `SETTABLE_SETTINGS`; any other name is rejected with
`CmdError::InvalidParams` at `/member`, listing the settable members. `value` is the member's whole
new value in its JSON shape (doc 03 §5.1), checked with the derivation's parser
(`ew_derive::check_settings_member`); a value it does not accept is rejected at `/value` with the
parser's message. A JSON `null` removes the member, so the pinned derivation profile's default applies.
A value equal to the stored one changes nothing.

Only the project record changes: no device, page or connection record is touched, so the topology is
identical, and the derived values that follow the member (tags, cross-reference texts, wire
properties) change on every page at once. Bulk: front-ends preview it and show the derived diff
(`ew_commands::derived_diff`, `Session::derived_diff`). Undoable as one step. Outcome: none.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `member` | string | yes |  | The member to set: a name of the settable table (`numbering`, `colour_profile`, `size_profile`, `xref_format`). |
| `value` | any JSON value | yes |  | The member's new value in its JSON shape; `null` removes it (the profile's default applies). |

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); the lines before it stay committed. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).

This is a bulk command: a log line runs it as a preview first and commits the previewed result ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)).
